hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git add[[:space:]]+(-A|--all|\.([[:space:]]|$))'; then echo 'ERROR: scoped commits only. Use git add with named paths, never -A, --all, or .'; exit 1; fi

file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$file" ] && echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.(tsx|ts|jsx|js|md|mdx|jsonc|css|html)$'; then if grep -q '\xe2\x80\x94' "$file" 2>/dev/null; then echo "ERROR: em dash found in $file. Remove it before continuing."; exit 1; fi; fi
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && npm run -s typecheck 2>&1 | tail -20; exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}
osascript -e 'display notification "Claude Code is done" with title "txasm"' 2>/dev/null || notify-send 'txasm' 'Claude Code is done' 2>/dev/null || true
